whatIs.heading: What is an AI itinerary generator?
whatIs.definition: An AI itinerary generator takes a destination and a number of days and returns a finished schedule — which places, in what order, on which day — instead of a list of options to sort out yourself.
whatIs.distinguish: The hard part is not picking good places. It is sequencing them: keeping each day geographically coherent, leaving room to eat and travel between stops, and not stranding you across the city at the wrong hour.
whatIs.product: MonkeyTravel produces a full day-by-day plan in about 30 seconds, with real places and cost estimates at the budget level you choose. Every block can be moved or replaced afterwards.
whatIs.example: A three-day Lisbon plan should keep Belém in one block rather than scattering it across two mornings. That kind of ordering is most of what the generator is for.
whatIs.honest: No generator gets a city right on the first pass. Treat the output as a strong first draft you edit, not a plan to follow blindly.

howFast.question: How fast does it generate an itinerary?
howFast.answer: MonkeyTravel generates a complete day-by-day itinerary in about 30 seconds, at the budget level you choose (Budget, Balanced or Premium), with real places, cost estimates and optimized time blocks, ready to change or export.

howAccurate.question: How accurate are the generated itineraries?
howAccurate.answer: The plan is written by AI, and any stop shows Google ratings, prices and photos a tap away. Once you save a trip, we check its places to eat on Google Maps and change any that have closed. We recommend confirming details, including opening hours, close to your travel date.

multiCity.question: Can it generate multi-city itineraries?
multiCity.answer: Yes. MonkeyTravel supports multi-city trip planning. You can generate connected itineraries that cover multiple destinations in a single trip, with logical routing and transition days between cities.

exportFormats.question: Can I export or share my itinerary?
exportFormats.answer: Absolutely. You can export your generated itinerary as a PDF, share it via a unique link with travel companions, or sync it to your calendar. A saved trip you've opened once also stays readable offline while you travel.

isFree.question: Is the AI itinerary generator free?
isFree.answer: Yes, MonkeyTravel's AI itinerary generator is completely free. You can generate itineraries with no credit card required, no trial period, and no hidden fees. All features — including export, sharing, and multi-city support — are included at no cost.
